title: WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_POOL_SIZE=8: no documentation on how to choose the value
description: WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_POOL_SIZE defaults to 8. If a caller has more than 8 concurrent AES/hash operations, extra operations get WC_HW_E immediately with no diagnostic. There is no blocking fallback, no error indicating the pool is exhausted vs a device failure. Scenario: TLS server with 16 threads all doing AES-GCM simultaneously; half the operations get WC_HW_E which looks like hardware failure. Maintenance consequence: repeated confusing hardware error reports that are actually a tuning issue.
